verdict.rationale: HubSpot's endpoint reference pages each publish a machine-readable OpenAPI 3.0.1 spec inline, pointing to versioned JSON spec files (e.g. specs/2026-09/account-account-info-v2026-09.json). The docs are also agent-readable via /docs/llms.txt and .md page variants. The probe 404s hit generic root paths (/openapi.json, /llms.txt), not the documented per-endpoint locations, so they do not contradict the claim. missing for 10: a single consolidated, discoverable spec download covering the whole API, and independent or hands-on confirmation that the per-endpoint spec files are directly downloadable.
